title: VooPoo Vinci Spark 220 Vape Kit
description: The Voopoo Vinci Spark 220 Kit is a feature-rich dual-18650 sub-ohm vape kit, combining striking aesthetics with high-powered performance. With a maximum 220W output, an intuitive 1.47” TFT screen, and an array of customisable vaping modes, this kit is built for vapers who demand both power and precision. At its core is the GENE.TT 2.0 chipset, delivering Smart, RBA, and TC-TRC modes to suit different vaping styles. Smart Mode automatically adjusts power based on coil resistance, while RBA Mode offers full control from 5W to 220W. TC-TRC Mode enables precise temperature control for Ni200, Titanium, and stainless steel coils. A standout feature of the Vinci Spark 220 is its Animated Starlight Coating, which incorporates 84 embedded LEDs that create a mesmerising light effect across the device. These lighting effects are fully customisable via UI themes, with the option to turn them off for a more discreet experience. Paired with the Uforce X sub-ohm tank, the Vinci Spark 220 ensures a premium Direct-to-Lung (DTL) experience. The tank features a 2ml top-fill design, adjustable top airflow, and PnP X coil compatibility, providing exceptional flavour and vapour production. The Vinci Spark 220 is powered by dual 18650 batteries (sold separately) and supports 5V/3A USB-C fast charging. A magnetic battery cover ensures seamless installation and a secure fit. The multi-function button makes navigation intuitive, allowing users to fire up their vape, switch lighting effects on or off, and access device settings effortlessly. With seven safety protections, including overcharge, short-circuit, and temperature protection, the Vinci Spark 220 is built for both performance and reliability. For a single-battery, 100W version of this device, check out the Voopoo Vinci Spark 100 Kit and Mod. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
